title: polypodium nummularium
intro: Polypodium nummularium, commonly known as Money Plant or Silver Vine, is a species of flowering plant in the fern family, Polypodiaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, including reducing stress and anxiety, and promoting a good night's sleep due to its sedative effects. The health benefits of Polypodium nummularium are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include sedation, anxiolysis, and muscle relaxation, as well as its ability to reduce inflammation and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of the plant include polypodine, polyprenyl, and polyprenylated benzylidene derivatives, which have been identified as responsible for its therapeutic effects.
